INSIDE THE AGENT

Curiosity, with a purpose.

Each question separates possible taste directions. Your answer changes which direction the model explores.

How this works

The agent chooses the available film with the largest expected information gain across three experimental profiles. Like and dislike update model weights; unfamiliar leaves them unchanged. These weights are not probabilities of your enjoyment.

THE QUESTION WE’RE TESTING

Can three good questions beat a long questionnaire?

The optional paired pilot compares adaptive and fixed questions using the same Qloo evidence and a mixed shortlist. Voluntary user ratings are needed to test improvement. This experience demonstrates the mechanism, not an established outcome.
